methodology: AI-assisted source-checked draft, awaiting independent human review. Regression split already inspected in v0.1, not an unseen holdout. Chunk ranking from search, independent of answer refusal; expected-document IDs bound through verified file hashes. Case pass requires expected source actually used, not just retrieved.
